name: NPM-GH
tagline: High-speed, labour-saving placement for SMT lines

intro.text: The Panasonic NPM-GH is a component placement machine from the NPM-G series, built to reduce operator work on the line. It handles parts from 0201 chips up to large components, on single or dual lanes.

items: Up to 55,500 cph (0.065 s/chip) with the 16-nozzle head
Placement accuracy down to ±10 μm/chip with the 3-nozzle head
Tape, stick and tray component supply, up to 80 feeder inputs (4 mm / 8 mm tape)
Components from 0201 chips up to L 150 × W 25 × T 30 mm

rows: L 50 × W 50 to L 510 × W 590 mm
L 50 × W 50 to L 510 × W 300 mm

16-nozzle head: 55,500 cph (0.065 s/chip)
8-nozzle head: 51,000 cph (0.071 s/chip)
3-nozzle head: 20,000 cph (0.180 s/chip)
±25 μm/chip, ±15 μm/chip, ±10 μm/chip (±10 μm with ASF only)
0201 chip to L 120 × W 90 × T 30 mm or L 150 × W 25 × T 30 mm

blocks.text: Standard specifications from Panasonic. Actual performance depends on usage conditions.
